pages.text: Fishing boats came twice a day: once in the morning, once as the sun sank. They sold fish from big water tubs.
Bung wanted to show Ddori the biggest fish. "After our meal, let us go see."
Bung ate very slowly, slurping noodles one strand at a time.
Ddori was finished and watched. Bung slurped another strand. "A little longer."
Customers grew louder outside. Bung drank even the last broth.
Bung went to the fishing boat. The big tub was empty.
Only one tiny fish remained at the bottom. Ddori peered in.
Mom tapped the empty tub. "Come later, and only the leftovers remain."
As the sun sank, the fishing boat returned. Bung put down the dinner bowl and took Ddori's hand.
A big fish flapped in the tub. Ddori's eyes went round.
